## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences: what does this PR change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New method / new exported function
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Internal refactor / infrastructure
- [ ] Other (describe)

## Checklist

- [ ] `devtools::document()` — `NAMESPACE` and `man/` are in sync.
- [ ] `devtools::test()` — all tests pass locally.
- [ ] `devtools::check()` — 0 errors / 0 warnings (notes triaged).
- [ ] `NEWS.md` updated under the relevant heading.
- [ ] New exported functions are tested, have roxygen docs with a runnable
  example, and are added to the function reference table in `README.md`.
